description: Rewrites the open (unsent) cadence messages of people in ONE campaign with the AI writer, from the campaign's current template. It takes no instructions and does not change the template or a step's text or day. Steps that already sent, failed, or are mid-dispatch are kept. Optional prospectIds limit the rewrite to those people; without them everyone with unsent steps is refreshed. channels or days limit it to the steps the user named ("os e-mails", "o passo 3"); every other step stays as it is. Nothing is sent. Free.

channels.description: Only these channels' steps are written again ("reescreve os e-mails" is ["email"]); the other steps stay exactly as they are. Absent: the whole cadence.

days.description: Only the steps on these days ("o passo 3" is the day of the cadence's third step); the other steps stay exactly as they are. Absent: every step.

prospectIds.description: When set, only these people are rewritten.

name: regenerate_outreach_cadence
title: Regenerar textos da cadência
